plugins.description: Test bench for model-harness lanes: your session architects, specs, and verifies; a configurable fleet of CLI lanes (grok, codex, claude harnesses + third-party models via env shims) implements. Includes A/B cost measurement so you can find the right pairing for your own tasks.
